sections.text:
Criteria to determine if the 
combustion chamber caps and liners
should be reused, repaired, or scrapped.

Checking and sizing of louver openings 
is not generally recommended except for those louvers which have been repaired.

Repaired louver openings should be sized to .005" of drawings
or comparison dimension, with care taken to maintain a .350" to
 .375" minimum 
width of louve opening

combustion chamber caps and liners
should be reused, repaired, or scrapped.
NOTE
Checking and sizing of louver openings 
is not generally recommended except for those louvers which have been repaired.

or comparison dimension, with care taken to maintain a .350" to
 .375" minimum 
width of louve opening
